questions.question: Which two signs should be interchanged to balance the given equation? 4 × 3 + 10 - 2 ÷ 7 = 10
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs should be interchanged to balance the given equation?

4 × 3 + 10 - 2 ÷ 7 = 10
questions.solution:
Given equation is :

4 × 3 + 10 - 2 ÷ 7 = 10

To balance the equation :

(I). 4 × 3 + 10 - 2 ÷ 7 = 10

Interchanging ( × and + ) and using BODMAS rule,

4 + 3 × 10 - 2 ÷ 7 = 10

4 + 3 × 10 - 0.28 = 10

4 + 30 - 0.28 = 10

34 - 0.28 = 10

33.72 ≠ 10.

LHS ≠ RHS.

(II). 4 × 3 + 10 - 2 ÷ 7 = 10

Interchanging ( ÷ and - ) and using BODMAS rule,

4 × 3 + 10 ÷ 2 - 7 = 10 

4 × 3 + 5 - 7 = 10 

12 + 5 - 7 = 10 

17 - 7 = 10 

10 = 10.

LHS = RHS.

(III). 4 × 3 + 10 - 2 ÷ 7 = 10

Interchanging ( + and - ) and using BODMAS rule,

4 × 3 - 10 + 2 ÷ 7 = 10

4 × 3 - 10 + 0.28 = 10

12 - 10 + 0.28 = 10

12.28 - 10 =10

2.28 ≠ 10.

LHS ≠ RHS.

(IV). 4 × 3 + 10 - 2 ÷ 7 = 10

Interchanging ( ÷ and × ) and using BODMAS rule,

4 ÷  3 + 10 - 2 × 7 = 10

1.33 + 10 - 2 × 7 = 10

1.33 + 10 - 14 = 10

11.33 - 14 = 10

-2.67 ≠ 10.

LHS ≠ RHS.

Hence, the correct answer is "÷ and -".

questions.question: Which two numbers, from amongst the given options, should be interchanged to make the given equation correct? (6) 2 – 20 + (28 ÷ 7) – \(\left[ {\left( {\sqrt 4 } \right) \times 8} \right]\) + (2) 2 = 40
questions.questionHtml:
Which two numbers, from amongst the given options, should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

(6)2 – 20 + (28 ÷ 7) – \(\left[ {\left( {\sqrt 4 } \right) \times 8} \right]\) + (2)2 = 40
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

We have to interchange the two numbers to make the given equation correct.

Let's check the option one by one.

Option 1) 6 and 8

Given : (6)2 – 20 + (28 ÷ 7) – \(\left[ {\left( {\sqrt 4 } \right) \times 8} \right]\) + (2)2 = 40

After interchanging the numbers we get the:

⇒ (8)2 – 20 + (28 ÷ 7) – \(\left[ {\left( {\sqrt 4 } \right) × 6} \right]\) + (2)2 = 40

⇒ 64 - 20 + 4 - 2 × 6 + 4 = 40

⇒ 64 - 20 + 4 - 12 + 4 = 40

⇒ 72 - 20 - 12 = 40

⇒ 40 = 40 

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 2) 7 and 2

Given : (6)2 – 20 + (28 ÷ 7) – \(\left[ {\left( {\sqrt 4 } \right) \times 8} \right]\) + (2)2 = 40

After interchanging the numbers we get the:

⇒ (6)2 – 20 + (28 ÷ 2) – \(\left[ {\left( {\sqrt 4 } \right) × 8} \right]\) + (7)2 = 40

⇒ 36 - 20 + 14 - 2 × 8 + 49 = 40

⇒ 36 - 20 + 14 - 16 + 49 = 40

⇒ 99 - 20 - 16 = 40

⇒ 63 ≠ 40

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) 2 and 8

Given : (6)2 – 20 + (28 ÷ 7) – \(\left[ {\left( {\sqrt 4 } \right) \times 8} \right]\) + (2)2 = 40

After interchanging the numbers we get the:

⇒ (6)2 – 20 + (28 ÷ 7) – \(\left[ {\left( {\sqrt 4 } \right) × 2} \right]\) + (8)2 = 40

⇒ 36 - 20 + 4 - 2 × 2 + 64 = 40

⇒ 36 - 20 + 4 - 4 + 64 = 40

⇒ 104 - 20 - 4 = 40

⇒ 80 ≠ 40

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) 20 and 8

Given : (6)2 – 20 + (28 ÷ 7) – \(\left[ {\left( {\sqrt 4 } \right) \times 8} \right]\) + (2)2 = 40

After interchanging the numbers we get the:

⇒ (6)2 – 8 + (28 ÷ 7) – \(\left[ {\left( {\sqrt 4 } \right) × 20} \right]\) + (2)2 = 40

⇒ 36 - 8 + 4 - 2 × 20 + 4 = 40

⇒ 36 - 8 + 4 - 40 + 4 = 40

⇒ 44 - 8 - 40 = 40

⇒ - 4 ≠ 40

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "6 and 8".

questions.question: Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct? (50 ÷ 3) × 15 + 25 − 10 = 25

questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

In this question, two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct.

Given: (50 ÷ 3) × 15 + 25 − 10 = 25

Option 1) ÷ and -

After interchanging the two signs we get the;

⇒ (50 - 3) × 15 + 25 ÷ 10 = 25

⇒ 47 × 15 + 25 ÷ 10 = 25

⇒ 47 × 15 + 2.5 = 25

⇒ 705 + 2.5 = 25

⇒ 707.5 ≠ 25

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) + and × 

After interchanging the two signs we get the;

⇒ (50 ÷ 3) + 15 × 25 − 10 = 25

⇒ 16.66 + 15 × 25 - 10 = 25

⇒ 16.66 + 375 - 10 = 25

⇒ 391.66 - 10 = 25

⇒ 381.66 ≠ 25

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) ÷ and × 

After interchanging the two signs we get the;

⇒ (50 × 3) ÷ 15 + 25 − 10 = 25

⇒ 150 ÷ 15 + 25 - 10 = 25

⇒ 10 + 25 - 10 = 25

⇒ 35 - 10 = 25

⇒ 25 = 25

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 4) + and − 

After interchanging the two signs we get the;

⇒ (50 ÷ 3) × 15 - 25 + 10 = 25

⇒ 16.66 * 15 - 25 + 10 = 25

​⇒ 249.9 - 25 + 10 = 25

​⇒ 259.9 - 25 = 25

​⇒ 234.9 ≠ 25

​⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
